description: LITTLE ROCK —  This week, Tom Cotton announced a bill he says would lower the cost of gasoline that has skyrocketed since the beginning of the war in Iran he championed. “Arkansans are rightfully feeling pressure at the pump,” said Senator Cotton in a press release on his website a
title: Tom Cotton says “Arkansans are rightfully feeling pressure at the pump.” Cotton is wrong, there is nothing right about the war that is costing Arkansans at the pump. — Hallie Shoffner for Senate 2026
